items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Louis used to do guest shots with Bing Crosby

ctx.x: Louis used to do guest shots with Bing Crosby, and Duke used to do a lot of guest shots on radio, as a duo though. Duke and Jimmy Blanton. They used to do a lot of things on radio -- on big radio shows. You'd very often hear Blanton and Duke playing together.
